# Titus Brings Good News (2 Corinthians 7:15)

## Emotional Focus
Being a friend who brings good news and cheer.

## Key KJV
“And his inward affection is more abundant toward you.” (2 Corinthians 7:15)

## Gentle Retelling
Titus was sent to help the church and brought back happy news that made Paul’s heart glad. He was a true encouraging friend.

## Coloring Prompt
Titus running to Paul with a joyful letter in hand.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Good friends bring joy to each other’s hearts.”
